description: This file defines synchronization utilities for API locking, including thread-local flags, lock management templates, and registration functions for API methods with locking mechanisms.

classes.name: ApiLocks
classes.description: Template struct managing a recursive mutex for each class type to synchronize API access.

classes.name: UnlockApiGuard
classes.description: Template guard class that unlocks the API mutex upon construction if the thread is using a locked API, and re-locks it upon destruction.

classes.name: LockApiGuard
classes.description: Template guard class that manages locking and unlocking of the API mutex using a unique_lock.

methods.name: getFunctionToCall
methods.description: Creates a function wrapper that locks the API mutex, calls the specified method, and manages thread-local flags.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApi
methods.description: Registers an API method with locking support for a specific object.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApiForVersions
methods.description: Registers an API method with version support and locking.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApiForHandler
methods.description: Registers an API method with a JSONRPC handler with locking support.
